title: MEIKO — Dependable Warmth〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The girls really put on such an incredible show...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (With each passing song, their performance just kept getting better and filled the venue with so much energy.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I watched them practice their full set multiple times, but they couldn't have played better. Or with more power.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It was filled with so much exuberance that I found myself wanting to sing along.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, the fill Honami threw in during their sixth song was very cool.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think it went something like this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, that didn't sound right...
Oh, I think it's the snare at the end!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! This is it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
MEIKO, what was that?!
It sounded really cool!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, Len, hello!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Didn't Honami play that during the solo show?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, she did. I was just thinking about the girls' show and remembered the fill she played. So, I decided to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That show was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I almost cried during the third song when Ichi played her guitar solo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She lifted everyone up so high as she sang and really hammered it home with her guitar!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, she really nailed the string bends for that part!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I got goosebumps just listening to her play.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Without that, I feel you'd lose a lot of that rock 'n' roll sound.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? When did you all get here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, we just stopped by to see who was playing the drums in such a fun way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We also heard you talking from the corridor.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I guess we kept on talking with the door open.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I see that now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So, what brings you all here?
Were you hoping to play something together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, we did bring our instruments with us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! You all came prepared.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, we're gonna have a session?!
Lemme go grab my synth!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I'll get my stuff too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like to play something the girls played during their show...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. It should be fun to play what they did while talking about what happened.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, why don't we start with their first song and play all of them? We can talk about what we liked about it and such!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure, let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay. They mentioned that they'll be holding their debrief after things have settled down, so this may help for when they do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Already?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You definitely seem the most eager.
But we should wait for Rin and Len to return, or risk incurring their wrath.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're back!
Give us one sec to set up♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay!
By the way, we decided to play every song from their set.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All of them?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Awesome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let us know when you're ready!
I'll count us in once you are!
